modelIdentification.name: BGWS-Events
modelIdentification.purpose: The BGWS simulation's event log, one interaction per event
modelIdentification.description: BGWS_Event: what happened, when, to and by whom, where, in a line for people and as JSON for machines. BGWS_Control: load a scenario into a waiting BGWS simulation and run it.

interactionClass.name: BGWS_Event
interactionClass.semantics: Something a BGWS simulation logged: a detection, a shot, a hit, an order, a decision, a message, a loss.

parameter.name: Kind
parameter.semantics: Dotted kind, e.g. sense.detect, fire.hit, fire.kill, c2.order_received, decide.answer, smoke.screen, laser.designate.

parameter.name: Sequence
parameter.semantics: The event's number in its simulation's log, from 0. With Federate, a unique key.

parameter.name: SimTime
parameter.semantics: Simulated seconds since the game started.

parameter.name: Federate
parameter.semantics: The federate name of the simulation that logged it.

parameter.name: Side
parameter.semantics: blue, red, ... or empty.

parameter.name: Entity
parameter.semantics: The object instance name of the entity that did it or that it happened to (as RPR interactions name entities), or empty.

parameter.name: EntityUniqueId
parameter.semantics: That entity's NETN UniqueId as text (8-4-4-4-12 hex), or empty.

parameter.name: EntityCallsign
parameter.semantics: That entity's name, or empty.

parameter.name: Target
parameter.semantics: The object instance name of the other entity involved, or empty.

parameter.name: TargetUniqueId
parameter.semantics: Its NETN UniqueId as text, or empty.

parameter.name: TargetCallsign
parameter.semantics: Its name, or empty.

parameter.name: Latitude
parameter.semantics: Where the entity was, degrees (WGS-84); NaN if no entity.

parameter.name: Longitude
parameter.semantics: Degrees (WGS-84); NaN if no entity.

parameter.name: Altitude
parameter.semantics: Metres above the WGS-84 ellipsoid; NaN if no entity.

parameter.name: Text
parameter.semantics: One line for people.

parameter.name: Data
parameter.semantics: The figures and values behind the event, as a JSON object (at most 16 KB; a longer one is replaced by {"truncated": true}).

interactionClass.name: BGWS_Control
interactionClass.semantics: A command to a BGWS simulation waiting in the federation (bgws federate): load a scenario, start, pause, resume, stop, or change speed. It answers with BGWS_Event kind federate.status.

parameter.name: Federate
parameter.semantics: The federate name addressed; empty for every BGWS simulation.

parameter.name: Command
parameter.semantics: load, start, pause, resume, stop or speed.

parameter.name: RequestId
parameter.semantics: The caller's id for this command, echoed in the status events that answer it.

parameter.name: Scenario
parameter.semantics: For load: the scenario as JSON (format bgws.foundry version 1, or bgws.scenario version 4).

parameter.name: Options
parameter.semantics: A JSON object, e.g. {"speed": 2.0}: simulated seconds per wall-clock second.
